farmers-world.description: Farmers World, trading as Surbola N.V., is Suriname's best known supplier of veterinary medicine and livestock supplies. The Lelydorp store on Indira Gandhiweg stocks animal health products, vaccines and treatments for poultry, cattle, pigs and small livestock, alongside feed supplements, farming tools, agricultural machinery and spare parts. Farmers across Wanica and Saramacca come here as much for the staff's product advice as for the stock itself.

brasa-suriname.description: Brasa is a Brazilian steakhouse on the Anton Dragtenweg in Paramaribo that calls itself the “Brazilian Steak Avenue”. The menu centres on churrasco-style grilled steaks and sausages, with seafood on the side, served in a lively setting that mixes Brazilian and Surinamese hospitality. Regular music nights accompany dinner; reservations go through WhatsApp.
